Topic 1. Your development environment

Success: Complete
Complete

All videos completed

All readings completed

All graded assessments completed

In this topic, you will learn about three key concepts: the toolkit we will use to develop programs; drawing using simple shapes and 2D coordinates; and the process and experience of writing code.
  1. 1.1.1. Set up the programming tool kit and use it to edit and run programs.
  2. 2.1.2. Use built-in drawing functions and 2D coordinates to draw simple shapes on the screen.
  3. 3.1.3. Describe the process of writing code.
